name: AI Mode Plugin for FPP
author: jessica12ryan
description: Configure and control Falcon Player (FPP) using natural language via major AI platforms. Link OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, Grok, OpenRouter, Ollama (local, not installed by default) and more with API tokens to create playlists, schedules, channel outputs and settings from typed prompts. Includes conversational assistant with tool-calling execution with approval and full FPP API coverage.

privacy.summary: Sends prompts and FPP context to your chosen AI provider to generate config actions. Nothing sent unless you click Send.
